derivations.p3: Equal bridge resistors midpoint X virtual ground, PNP bases X fixed. Av=-gm1(ro1||ro3||R1).
derivations.p5: Unloaded MOS cascode two-node KCL: x/ro1+(x-y)/ro3+gm3*x+gm1vi=0; (y-x)/ro3-gm3*x=0. Exact A=-gm1ro1(1+gm3ro3). Matched approximate A=(gmro)^2=4K/(lambda²ISS); ISS=14.8148mA for300. Exact current slightly larger; must disclose gmro≈17.
derivations.p6: Telescopic: I=.5mA, ron20k,rop10k; gmN=sqrt(1e-7 S),gmP=sqrt(5e-8 S). Rn=2ron+gmN ron²,Rp=2rop+gmP rop². Exact Gm=gmN(gmN+1/ron)/(gmN+2/ron); A=-Gm(Rn||Rp). Approx -gmN[(gmN ron²)||(gmP rop²)] gives S≈33.3? calculate executable before compare; exact likely29.8. Derive symbolic ratio→1 as gm scale→∞.
derivations.p7: BJT finite beta upper base loading. Let z=VA/VT, rpi=beta/gm. Exact |A|=beta z(1+z)/(beta+z); high intrinsic approximate beta z²/(beta+z). beta100, target4000 gives z approx86.33,VA≈2.16V VT25mV. Finite correction 1/z; preserve exact formula.

derivations.p9: CM BJT tail IC=IEE, gm_input=IC/(2VT), rt=VA/IC. Half degeneration2rt -> ACM=-RC/(2VT/IC+2VA/IC)=-RC IC/[2(VA+VT)]. Bound gives RCIC<.02(VA+VT). Finite input beta neglected.
